description: Vadim Arzamasov publishes 10,000 simulated stability cases for a four-node electricity network using decentralised smart-grid control. The generator places a producer at the centre of a star and varies participant reaction times, nominal production or consumption, and coefficients related to price elasticity. Output fields give the largest real part of a characteristic-equation root and a stable or unstable label. Coverage is a synthetic topology, with no geographical grid or calendar observation period. The 2018 UCI deposit provides CSV data free under CC BY 4.0. A limitation is that coupling strength, damping and averaging time are held fixed, while producer power is determined by the sum of consumer powers. Its normalised dynamical power variables should not be silently interpreted as MW. Simulation uses include benchmarking local stability classifiers and testing control-parameter sensitivity. It complements data-pglib-opf, whose power-system cases serve a different optimisation task. No CSV or executable generator was downloaded or run.
